latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of gov-disaster-intel: real-time disaster monitoring tools.

- Access FEMA disaster declarations, NOAA weather alerts, and USGS earthquake data in one skill.
- Three tools: search FEMA disaster records, get active weather alerts, and search global earthquake events.
- No API keys required; free direct access to US government data sources.
- Simple setup for OpenClaw MCP servers and command-line use.
- Supports use cases such as emergency preparedness, travel safety, and risk assessment.
